title: Orchestrator sandbox image and headless harness bootstrap
description: The container one cloud run boots. Define the sandbox image and its entrypoint: git plus the language toolchains the target repo needs, a pinned omp (or claude) CLI, the ticks skill installed the normal way, and an entrypoint that clones the repo at the submitted SHA, verifies the tk version, runs the .tick/config.md Environment pre-flight, exports TK_ACTOR=cloud:orchestrator, and starts the headless harness on the skill loop. Model traffic must point at the AI Gateway base URL from the environment, never a vendor default. Harness output streams continuously to stdout so the Workflow can ship it to R2 during the run, never export-at-exit. Independent of the worker-side routes, so it can land in wave 1.
acceptance_criteria: The image builds reproducibly and its entrypoint, given a repo URL, SHA and gateway base URL, reaches the point of running the skill loop; the pre-flight failure path exits nonzero with the failing check named; harness output appears on stdout as it is produced, not at exit.
